title: Civic research with AI
description: Guides a two-phase conversation that explores a level of government in the user's jurisdiction, then pastes back a set of Questions under that civic-level node.

variables.name: levelLabel
variables.description: Tree label of the civic-level node (e.g. `State`, `SLD Upper Chamber`).

variables.name: semanticType
variables.description: Civic scope key of the level (e.g. `state`, `county`).

variables.name: jurisdiction
variables.description: Resolved place for this level. Omit when the civic ladder has no data; the prompt then tells the AI not to invent place names.

variables.name: questionText
variables.description: Current text of the civic-level Question, with tree markers already replaced by punctuation (❓ → ?). The root bullet gets a ❓ appended unless the text already contains one.

surfaces: My Vision → Options → Civic research with AI (`civic_research`: a civic-level Question with a civic scope key)

usage.notes: Paste-back is Questions only. The root bullet gets a ❓ marker when the question text has none.
